name: SSR StockMind — Industrial Raw Materials & Agro-Manufacturing ERP
description: Enterprise industrial inventory & raw materials decision intelligence platform modeled on SSR Group of Industry (Flour Mills, Feed Mills, Edible Oil Refineries, Auto Rice Mills, Grain Silos, and Port Logistics). Real-time silo runway tracking, daily factory consumption, import lead-time forecasting, supplier reorder matrix in BDT, and multi-turn AI copilot with interactive Voice Commands.
